description:
A `lua://` source: Lua code returns the rows; it sees the arguments, the template and
the `dbdash.*` helpers. Runs Lua, so it asks for trust first. See `:help dbdash-lua`.

args.name: wave
args.description: Add a sine wave to the load

show.title: Lua data source
show.description:
`{{ args.days }}` days of load computed in Lua (`args.base`, a sine wave when
`args.wave`), the host name from `dbdash.system()`; `dbdash.null` is NULL inside a row
and `dbdash.checkpoint()` lets the editor run during long loops.
